// diagnostic

E3218

The C callback {callback} reads `context.{member}`.

What

The C callback {callback} reads `context.{member}`.

Why

C calls a callback on a thread it chooses, where no Jet task runs, so there is no task context to read.

Fix

Read the value before the foreign call and pass it to the callback through C, or drop the read.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E3218: tests/ui/cffi_callback_context_read.stderr.

Error [jet.CallbackReadsContext]: The C callback `stamp` reads `context.thread`.
  --> tests/ui/cffi_callback_context_read.jet:17:18
    |
 17 |     print(c.call(stamp, 1))
    |                  ^^^^^
 Why: C calls a callback on a thread it chooses, where no Jet task runs, so there is no task context to read.
 Fix: Read the value before the foreign call and pass it to the callback through C, or drop the read.
